title: The Echo Hall
story: You and NOVA are recording sounds in the school's music hall when the doors lock. NOVA is learning to recognise sounds. It must get them right to open the doors.
escaped: The doors swing open. NOVA now sorts sounds by frequency, knows sound needs a medium and predicts pitch from data.

locks.title: Can we hear it?
locks.intro: NOVA must sort sounds into audible (we can hear them) and inaudible for humans. Choose its clues.

test.name: An earthquake's deep rumble below 20 Hz

locks.hint: A lion is an animal and an earthquake rumble is loud. What really decides whether our ears can hear a sound?
locks.learn: We can only hear frequencies from about 20 to 20,000 vibrations per second. Clues like 'made by an animal' fitted NOVA's examples by accident.

locks.title: Check NOVA's Moon plan
locks.intro: NOVA is planning a Moon mission. Is this right? Decide and pick the fact that settles it.
locks.claim: Astronauts on the Moon can talk to each other directly, without radios.
evidence: Sound needs a medium (a solid, liquid or gas) to travel; it can't travel through a vacuum, and the Moon has no air.
The Moon has no light of its own.
Sound is produced by vibrating objects.
locks.hint: What does sound need to travel through?
locks.learn: An AI that hasn't connected two facts (sound needs a medium; the Moon has no air) can make dangerous plans. Checking each step of the reasoning catches it.

locks.title: Predict the pitch
locks.intro: NOVA measured how many times different things vibrate each second.
locks.question: A flute note vibrates 1,500 times a second. What will its pitch be?
options: Higher than the guitar string, lower than the bird's whistle.
Exactly the same as the guitar string.
locks.learn: The pattern (more vibrations per second, higher pitch) lets NOVA place a new sound it hasn't heard.

locks.title: Fix NOVA's noise facts
locks.intro: NOVA has notes on noise pollution. Tick the wrong ones.

rows.item: Loud noise for a long time
rows.label: Can cause lack of sleep

locks.hint: Which of these are ways the textbook suggests to REDUCE noise?
locks.learn: Two notes say the opposite of the truth. An AI trained on them would recommend the wrong actions.
